steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Woo—

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Been a while since I've had a ride like that!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: That's one damn fine car you've got, Jessica. Why don't you take it out more often?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Guess I picked the right ride, though we'll have to split up once we're at the frontier office. How about you let me drive back to the camp, before you go off on your solo mission?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hey, what's this red indicator light? And why are you so pale?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Three...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Third gear? No, that's too slow.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Two... One...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Helena...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I see it. Over there. The drivechain is broken.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Bridge the connection. A few turns of the spanner. Shouldn't take more than a minute or two.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: C'mon, no need for the long face. I know your mission's urgent, but it ain't like I've been slowing you down.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: We wouldn't even be halfway there if we followed the speed limit from that manual of yours.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The recommended speed was derived from various factors such as road conditions and weather... It's there for a reason.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You gonna let a machine like this run slower than a metal crab? You could fix this beaut a dozen times over in the time that I saved you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Fix it? Me?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You know what they say out in the barrens: Don't ask what's in someone else's pocket, and don't reach under someone else's car hood.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Anyway, I've taught you all my tricks. Our new sheriff can't very well have someone else fix her car for her every last time, can she?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But you're the one who—

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Alright, less yapping and more fixing. You're in a hurry, right? This ain't no place to dawdle. I'll buy you a pint from that saloon next to the office.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: N-No, I can't drink. I still have a mission to do.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Now, I know what you're thinking, but their stuff ain't like the swill we brew back at camp. It won’t knock you out with just a sip, like last time.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-I have no idea what you're talking about.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh dear, all these parts are loose now. We were really going too fast...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: What's that? You think that was fast? Let's see if we can't go faster.

spans.text: was fast? Let's see if we can't go faster.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh! Helena, er, go and get some rest. I'm just fetching some parts from the trunk.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: That's more like it. A sheriff's got to know how to fix her own car.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: What's with all those spare parts in the trunk? No wonder the center of gravity felt off.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But these are only the bare minimum required by the safety manual. I don't even have a set of tire repair tools. I hope we don't pop one on the way...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Man, you've gotten so damn stiff ever since Woody gave you that badge.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Fine, you do you. I'm gonna find some shade and enjoy the view. Gimme a holler when you're done.

steps.name: Faint Echo
steps.text: ♪She rides into the wilds, sunsets taken in tow♪

steps.name: Faint Echo
steps.text: ♪Too sneaky for the wind, the shadows are too slow♪

steps.name: Faint Echo
steps.text: ♪Never, never stopping, never setting foot at home♪

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Turn off the engines.

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: Is it really her? She dares show her face here, after all these years?

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Shut up! I'm listening.

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Yeah, it's her all right.

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Stay still! Did you forget?

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Wipe the lenses on those binoculars. Take a good long look and see where she's hiding.

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: I see her. The next corner. She's not alone. There's someone under... Did their car break down or something?

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: If we're doing this, we take out the one under the car first.

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: So what now? Do we just wait?

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Wait. But keep your knife and crossbow out.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: ♪Never, never stopping, never setting foot at home♪

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Ah, my throat's getting dry.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You done yet? It's getting late.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Almost, almost.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Sure you don't need any help?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Almost there. Just need to reinforce the welding...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Say, Helena... mind if I took the wheel? Don't worry, I don't have any violations on my license.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: No way. I get carsick if we go too slow.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Plus, I'm just hitching a ride, not going on your mission with you. You can drive however you want after we make it to the office.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Alright, give me another minute. I've got to check this again...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Can't you hurry it up a little? What happened to all that energy you had back at the camp?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Well, I guess I'll just keep enjoying the sunset. I think I'd get a better view from on top of this rock.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Cliff faces in the wilderness, changing color every second with the afterglow. Never get bored of it.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hm? What's that?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Alright, done. We can go now.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Helena?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What's going on?!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I smell something dirty in the wind.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Won't take the hint from the warning shot, but not brave enough to come down from the cliffs?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: A-A fight? I'll get my gun from under the seat...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: One sec, Jessica... no need.
Helena narrows her eyes and sweeps her gaze across the setting sun, the faintly purple shadows beneath the cliffs, and finally onto the girl whose sleeves are blackened with oil and grime.
There is a hint of nervousness in the girl's eyes, but underneath it her gaze is as firm as the badge on her chest.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Your mission's more important. No need to waste your time on these blood bags.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You fixed the car yet?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yeah, we can go now.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Then let's go.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Not in the passenger seat, egghead. How am I supposed to turn the wheel while aiming? You take the key.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Me? But...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: But drive fast this time, seriously.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: There are people coming down from the cliffs behind us! Looks like their cars have been modified too.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Not half as good-looking as yours, though.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: And they ain't half as good drivers, either, if they gotta slow down on such a gentle slope. Just keep the pedal to the metal and leave them to me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Do you know them?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Nah, made too many enemies to remember who's who. Not much of difference, though. It's usually the other side that picked the fight.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Keep your head down!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Why's this thing going so slow?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I added a speed limiter!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-I was afraid you'd be speeding again, so I added a speed limiter! It can't exceed the recommended speed limit now.
Helena pokes her upper body out of the window and points her nail gun at the dust cloud in the rear. The spiked vehicles that emerge from the dust cloud are promptly met by loud bangs from her hand.
Deadly metal streaks through the wind and sand until her magazine runs empty. The pursuers' numbers are greatly thinned by the time the sound of explosions is scattered by the wind.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You just...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Scum like these don't let go once they think they've got their mark. Keep your foot on the pedal and go as fast as you can! Don't give me that speed limit crap!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: O-Okay!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But this isn't safe at all!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You're still changing gears? What do you think this is, some kinda parade?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They're catching up! The speed... what do I do? What do I do?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Open the trunk!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Toss out all that junk you're carrying!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: All of it, now!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hurry! Trust me!
The car trunk flies wide open, and several massive metal toolboxes spill onto the ground, bouncing and rolling into the dust cloud.
The warped and battered locks can no longer contain their contents, so screws, rods and spanners, shiny and chrome, burst out from the boxes, forming a rain of iron.
This is followed by the joyous sounds of metal on metal, tires screeching to a halt on the gravel, and panicked cries and cursing.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sounds like it worked!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Still not enough! Toss out everything you can and smash their cars! I'll do it!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: A safety manual that I printed out at HQ to bring back to—

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You printed it? And it takes up a whole box? Out it goes!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: And this shield...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: NOT THAT!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I know, I know! We've still got a few seats...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Dammit, the backseats are screwed to the floor! Toss a wrench!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You threw them all out!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Let's try this!
With one hand on the wheel, Jessica draws her pistol, turns around, and fires at the thick and heavy screw.
Bang! A hole appears on the chassis, sending both the screw and backseats into the wilderness yonder.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Say something first next time, okay? I nearly went deaf.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry, I was in a hurry...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Shooting a gun in the car ain't exactly following the safety regulations, is it? But hey, nice shot...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: ...You did avoid hitting any important parts of the frame, right?

spans.text: avoid hitting any important parts of the frame, right?

steps.text: Jessica says nothing and casts a resigned look at Helena. It does not take long for her to understand why.
The whole vehicle begins to shake. Scrap begins to fly out from every gap and corner, all to the screeching sound of metal grinding against metal.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You should reload while you can... I don't know how long this thing's gonna last.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hey, is it just me, or are we going faster?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: We shouldn't be speeding up this much, even if we've shed quite a bit of weight... What about the limiter? Did you toss that, too?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No.
Jessica nods her head, then shakes it.
Helena turns around. The first thing she sees is Jessica's brow. The drops of sweat on it appeared out of nowhere in an instant.
The next thing she sees is the pointer needle on the instrument board, stuck and trembling at the rightmost side of the gauge. Also trembling are Jessica's hands on the wheel.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: ...Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...The accelerator pedal's stuck. And the brakes aren't working.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I think that shot might have, you know, grazed the brake wires... or maybe cut them in half...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Whoa!
For an instant, Helena's expression is frozen on her face. Then she starts to feel like she has never seen anything so funny in her life.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Haha... hahaha! This is FUN!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Enjoy the ride, kiddo! Forget safe driving! Forget navigation!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh? Forget...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Show some spirit, girlie! Let's lose these blood bags and forget they ever existed!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They can't catch us anymore!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: They can't even see our taillights!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: We don't HAVE any taillights left! But the point stands!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Good job! Now remember this feeling! The thrill! The excitement!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Woody could never teach you this. This moment belongs to you! Like the wind, like the setting sun!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I feel it!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: No one can tell you where to go! You're the one with the wheel in your hands!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: The future is the road in front of your eyes!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...My future is a cliff?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: No time! Jump!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hey, wake up! Do you want my business or not?

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Ugh... who's making all that noise?

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Oh, Helena! You're early today. Why are you covered in dirt?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: We got chased by a bunch of thugs and almost went out in a blaze of glory. How about you break out some 20-year vintage to celebrate my survival?

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: You know what I have. You can help yourself to last month's vintage at the bar.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Haven't seen YOU before, girl. Let's have a little chat.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Hello... just a glass of water, please.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: WATER? This here is an establishment for adults! If you're not with Helena...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: S-Sorry!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: C'mon, don't tease her. It's thanks to her that I'm still alive right now.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Hey, where's the ice? How am I supposed to drink this without any ice?

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: The ice machine's been broken for a week. You'd know if you stopped by more often.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I've been all over the place this week. My legs are so tired I can hardly move. Cut me some slack here.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: How about this? You give me the burdenbeast you have tied up at your door, and I'll fix your ice machine.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: No thank you, you're not taking Nux.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh no! Look at the time... We need to go to the office now, Helena!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Don't worry, I know what I'm doing. Let me have a drink first.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Now isn't the time!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: It's always the time to drink. Ain't that right, barkeep?

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Always the time for those who want to drink, and never the time for those who don't.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: This one's on me, Jessica. Drink it, or not. I did say I'd buy you a pint.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: The frontier office is twenty minutes to the north on foot. You'll even have time to wash your face.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What about you, Helena? Aren't you coming? Those bandits...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Don't worry about it. This saloon's safe. Those bandits can't get in.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: That's right. Wind gets in, rain gets in, but not bandit scum.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I was just hitching a ride anyway. Well, your car's in a better place now. You go your way, do your mission, and I'll head back to camp once I've had a drink.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Plus, those bandits won't give up so easily. You'll really be late if you stay with me and get caught up in this again.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Ha, Helena can take care of those idiots herself. Probably easier on her own anyway.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But... but I won't be a burden. I'm the sheriff of the camp. It's my job to deal with bandits.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Who said you were a burden? It's just, I've been going solo in the wilderness for longer than you've been alive. I haven't felt so young in a long time...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: And I'd feel guilty if I made you late. Go do what you gotta do. This is my problem; I'll deal with it.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Don't tell me you think I can't handle those thugs?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I get what you're saying, really.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But I'd feel guilty if I didn't do anything.

spans.text: feel guilty if I didn't do anything.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Why? Being the sheriff doesn't mean that's all you do, every day.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Duty, trust, protect... Do you think Woody only ever talks about that stuff all day?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Helena, I...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Well, I guess he doesn't talk much to begin with. Back to the point. How did you feel when you threw everything to the wind and put your foot on the pedal all the way down?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You can and should make choices that lie outside the rules.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You're young. Whatever you do, do it because you want to, not because someone else made you. Myself included.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Oh, how good it must be to be young... Hey, barkeep! You sure you don't want me to fix your ice machine? This swill's undrinkable without ice.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Absolutely not. I'm not the one who has to drink it.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Why do I have to beg you to let me help you? Since when were you so cold and distant?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I could try fixing the machine. I think I have enough time. As... a token of gratitude for letting us stay.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You're in luck. She's nearly as good as I am.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Sure. Come with me.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Time to clean up.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...There. Don't hit it too hard, and it should last quite a while.

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Where'd you learn to do that? And with old newspapers and broken glass? Helena, guess what... Helena?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: She put the money under the cup... didn't touch the contents at all. Is it really that bad?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *Cough* Argh! My throat! It burns!

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: She doesn't ever slow down, does she? Wait, this is way more than the price for two glasses...

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: She's never tipped so much before. Wait a second...

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Oh no! Nux!

steps.name: Saloon Keeper
steps.text: Helena! I'm charging you double from now on if Nux gets so much as a scratch on him, you hear me? DOUBLE!
Jessica and the barkeep run outside to see a figure riding into the sunset on the burdenbeast.
Their mixed expressions gradually grow mellow in the afterglow. The wind carries whistling and song, fading away in the distance.

a.text: ♪She rides into the wilds, sunsets taken in tow♪
♪Too sneaky for the wind, the shadows are too slow♪
♪Never, never stopping, never setting foot at home♪
♪Only lead and spirits keep her warm♪
♪Only lead and spirits keep her warm♪

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: You found her yet?

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: No, the tire tracks disappeared just before the cliff. Any footprints have been wiped away.

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Dagnabbit! She better not show her face ever again.

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: We just gonna let her go?

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: We got a choice? You think you could catch her? Has anyone, ever?

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: Wait! That way! I see her through the binoculars!

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: How many with her?

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: Just her, on a burdenbeast. But...

steps.name: Scarred Pioneer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: ...She just gestured towards me.

steps.name: Flustered Pioneer
steps.text: ...I think it's her who found us, boss.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Run. And good luck... you'll need it.
